news.headline: Central Florida Wed Nov 25 midday: NWS Melbourne Flood Watch through Thu 1 AM, Coastal Flood Advisory through Thu 11 AM, River Flood Warning and Rip Current Statement through Fri 1 AM, and Small Craft Advisory through Thu 7 PM remain in effect — Melbourne at noon rain 70°F, high near 71°F / low 62°F, rain chance easing after midday

Florida housing Oct 2026 — Florida Realtors Nov 16: existing single-family closed sales fell 10.1% year over year to 19,049, the third straight monthly decline, while the statewide median rose 2.2% to $420,000; condo-townhouse sales fell 5% to 6,862 with median down 3.3% to $290,000, and new pending single-family sales dropped 15.7% — next statewide release Dec 16

South Florida new homes Nov 2026 — Momentum tracker checked Nov 23 lists 14 Broward County communities, 10 selling, with Pulte's Coral Edge townhomes in Margate now from $510,990, down from $584,990 in October, and Toll Brothers' Hanson Preserve in Cooper City from $1,304,995

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper in a bear market Wed Nov 25 — WSJ: LME copper fell 2% Wednesday to $11,646 a metric ton, its lowest since December last year, on track for a 17% monthly decline; ScrapMonster Nov 25 put spot near $5.31/lb and reported North American copper scrap fell 25 cents/lb on Nov 24 for #1 Bare Bright, #1 and #2 Wire and Tubing, and #3 Light Copper, even as China's Yangshan import premium stayed near record levels around $450/ton

HVAC M&A multiples fall back to earth — ACHR News, updated Nov 24: average EBITDA multiples for HVAC companies have fallen from their 2021-2023 highs, smaller and midsize contractors have not necessarily seen the same decline, and private equity remains active in HVAC

Inflation rose Wed Nov 25 — Reuters / BEA: October PCE price index rose 0.3% in the month and 3.8% year over year, up from 3.6% in September, with core PCE up 3.3% year over year from 3.1%; financial markets have priced in a quarter-point Fed rate hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting from the current 3.75%-4.00% range
news.source: Reuters / U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis

news.headline: Wall Street slides Wed morning Nov 25 — as of about 10:43 AM ET the S&P 500 was down 2.70% at 7,007.01, the Nasdaq down 4.01% and the Dow down 1.56% amid an AI / chip sell-off, with the 10-year Treasury yield down 8 basis points to 4.82%; Bankrate put the average 30-year fixed mortgage at 7.34% Wednesday, and MBA said mortgage applications rose 6.1% in the week ended Nov 20 with purchase applications up 10%

NBA — Orlando Magic remain atop NBA Cup East Group A at 3-1 despite Tue Nov 24's 104-86 loss to Detroit, Isaiah Joe scoring 21 for the Pistons; Miami Heat are 2-0 and undefeated in Cup Group B, and Miami (10-6) visits the Philadelphia 76ers Wed Nov 25 at 5 PM ET in NBA Cup play

NFL — all three Florida teams lost Sun Nov 22: Detroit Lions beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-21, Buffalo Bills beat the Miami Dolphins 26-9, and New York Giants beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 23-18; Week ahead: Jets at Dolphins and Titans at Jaguars Sun Nov 29 at 1 PM, Panthers at Buccaneers Mon Nov 30 at 8:15 PM
